description: What the user has collected in Sightglass. Returns up to 100 boards with nextBoardCursor for more; pass boardCursor to continue. With no `kind` it adds a count summary; with `kind` it lists saved ads, landing pages (site_pages), companies or followed brands. Pass nextCursor as cursor for the next page of items. Fields the user's Replo plan doesn't include come back null and are named in that item's `locked` list (`estimates` = sales, visits and traffic); `lockedCount` is how many more results a higher plan shows. Say the data is on a higher plan; never estimate it yourself.

boardCursor.description: Pass nextBoardCursor from a prior result to list more boards.

boardId.description: Limit to one board; ids come from `boards` in this result.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page of this same call, to get the next page. Keep every other argument the same.

kind.description: Which saved items to list. Omit for just the boards and a count summary.

limit.description: Results per page: 20 by default, up to 40. Use the user's number when they give one; for more than 40, page with cursor.

projectId.description: Replo project id, from list_projects: where the charge or the asset lands. Its workspace's plan applies.

workspaceId.description: Replo workspace id, from list_workspaces. Sets which workspace's plan applies; required when the user has more than one workspace.

name: sightglass_list_saved
title: List saved items
